description: List the Deepstate markets (order books) this API serves, with each market’s slug, token layout, pool/router addresses, lifecycle `status`, and `reward_token`. `status` is one of `live`, `price_decode_pending`, `legacy` (token superseded, may still have resting orders), or `registered` (exists on-chain, not yet trading). `reward_token` is the token maker rewards pay in for that market — 2DEEP for NVDA/USDG since the DGP-3 migration on 2026-09-22; DEEP/USDG is legacy and pays no rewards. Call this first: every other Deepstate tool takes a book identifier, and this is the source of truth for which books exist and their canonical uppercase slug form (e.g. "NVDA-USDG"). Static configuration data, safe to cache client-side.
name: 1s_ds_markets
title: Deepstate Markets
